patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Closely and Demandbase share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Closely only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn + email outbound automation platform with enrichment, AI agents, and white-label ” rather than Demandbase's shape. Choose Demandbase only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-marke” rather than Closely's shape. Workflow advantage: Closely leans sales-engagement; Demandbase leans data-enrichment, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Closely and Demandbase share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Closely is LinkedIn + email outbound automation platform with enrichment, AI agents, and white-label options for agencies.; Demandbase is Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-market orchestration — custom-quote packaging..
- Workflow coverage skew: Closely-leaning sales-engagement vs Demandbase-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Closely — Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record.; Demandbase — Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices.

Limitations — Closely: Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record.; Plans are gated by LinkedIn sender seats and enrichment/AI credit bundles.; Demandbase: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices; Enterprise ABM scope means substantial implementation and change-management cost.
